comparison.objective: Close a drawer as far as possible without trapping a hand, versus finish threaded inserts and remove their tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Guarded prismatic pushing around an obstacle versus recessed alignment, bimanual hammering, lateral-load control, and small-fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Maximum safe drawer closure without hand entrapment versus four fractures and recovered tangs without coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both penalize damage, but their central mechanisms and abilities are materially different. Drawer-distance and clearance thresholds are not included.
